description: REST API for a todo list using TypeScript on Bun
global_context: Use TypeScript on Bun. Prefer built-in Bun APIs (Bun.serve, Bun.file, bun:sqlite) over third-party packages. When a dependency is truly needed, only use well-known packages with high GitHub stars and active maintenance.

tasks.description: Create package.json with bun-types, tsconfig.json with strict mode, and src/index.ts with a Bun.serve health-check endpoint returning {"status": "ok"} on GET /health
TDD: write failing tests in tests/models.test.ts first, then implement Todo types and validation in src/models.ts
TDD: write failing tests in tests/database.test.ts first, then implement src/database.ts using bun:sqlite with a todos table
TDD: write failing tests first, then add POST /todos endpoint to src/routes.ts that accepts a new todo and returns 201
TDD: write failing tests first, then add GET /todos endpoint to src/routes.ts that returns all todos
TDD: write failing tests first, then add PATCH /todos/:id endpoint to src/routes.ts that updates a todo. Return 404 if not found.
TDD: write failing tests first, then add DELETE /todos/:id endpoint to src/routes.ts that deletes a todo and returns 204. Return 404 if not found.
